mainEntity.name: Should I choose natural stone or porcelain tile for my project?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you are comparing natural stone to porcelain, porcelain is usually easier to maintain and more resistant to stains, while natural stone offers more variation and a more organic look. For busy homes in Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, or Parker, the better choice often comes down to how much upkeep you want.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose porcelain if you want easier maintenance and stronger stain resistance. Choose natural stone if you want a more natural, high-end look and are comfortable with more care.
